name: feather_tussock
notes: herb: A big feathergrass tussock standing out of the sward, its awns silver-gold and bent downwind; drawn as sprites, so you walk through it. v2: three muted coats in drifts about 35 m across.

morphs.name: silver
morphs.notes: Paler drifts where the awns catch the light.

morphs.name: sage
morphs.notes: Greener stands in the damp hollows.
